neighbours.label: the comma or 'and' right after perceiving 'this': 'When the captain saw this,', 'heard this and', 'Hearing this news,'; the reaction is about to follow
fire: When the guard noticed this, he ran to wake the others.
The old woman heard this and began to weep.
Seeing this, the merchant quietly closed his shop.
Hearing this terrible report, the queen sent for her generals.
My brother saw this and laughed out loud.
The thermostat senses this and shuts off the heater.
When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished.
Upon reading this, the editor picked up the phone.
quiet: When the guard noticed the smoke, he ran to wake the others.
The old woman heard the bell and began to weep.
Tired and cold, the merchant quietly closed his shop.
After a terrible week, the queen sent for her generals.
My brother saw a clown and laughed out loud.
The thermostat stands in the hall above the heater.
When the disciples arrived in town, they were greatly astonished.
Upon reaching home, the editor picked up the phone.
